topic: How many people ride Indian Railways every day?

hook.text: How many people ride Indian Railways every day?

lines.say: Last financial year, Indian Railways carried seven hundred and forty one crore passengers. That's about two crore people, every single day.
lines.cap: FY 2025-26: 741 CRORE passengers. That's about 2 crore people, every single day.

lines.say: And the shiny Vande Bharat trains? Three point nine eight crore passengers, up thirty four percent in one year!
lines.cap: And Vande Bharat? 3.98 CRORE passengers. Up 34% in one year!

lines.say: Not everyone gets on, mind you. Three point three nine crore passengers couldn't travel, because their waitlisted tickets never got confirmed.
lines.cap: Not everyone gets on, mind you. 3.39 CRORE passengers couldn't travel. Waitlisted tickets, never confirmed.
